summary: gh plate bootstrap now uploads nested template payload files with literal path separators so the GitHub contents API can create docs and workflow files correctly.
migration_impact: Downstream bootstrap runs no longer fail on nested scaffold files such as docs/wiki/Goals.md. No manual migration is required; rerun bootstrap to receive the nested template payload files successfully.
agent_notes: The GitHub contents API expects path separators to remain literal inside the endpoint path. Preserve '/' when building nested contents endpoints and only encode characters that truly need escaping.
